platforms.name: CFRC 101.9 FM Kingston Digital MP3 Email and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: Canada / Kingston, Ontario campus-community radio with a public digital email and physical music-library submission route
platforms.feeAmount: The direct CFRC email and physical submission routes state no submission fee. A separate optional !earshot Distro route requires an account and purchases and is not part of the free primary route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CFRC accepts digital files only through its published music mailbox and requires 320-kbps MP3s collected in one ZIP or archive, with explicit tracks identified and metadata, artist information and optional artwork checked before delivery. Physical media is also accepted. A human must prepare and approve the package, choose one route, and keep the optional account-based paid !earshot Distro workflow separate.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CFRC's official contact and submission policy and from current July 2026 station activity. The official business mailbox music@cfrc.ca is published specifically for submissions; other CFRC addresses and social-media delivery are explicitly rejected. No email was sent and no SMTP, MX or deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: JOY 94.9 Melbourne Stream-Link Email and Physical Music Submission Route
platforms.country: Australia / Melbourne independent community broadcaster with Australian and global music programming
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated for the official stream-link email or physical CD route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: JOY asks artists who are Australian, independent or part of LGBTIQA+ communities and whose music fits its daytime or specialist sound to send a stream link through the official music contact, with a physical CD and bio as an alternative. A human must confirm eligibility and programme fit, select the route and approve the pitch. The official music email is protected in the fetched page and was not decoded.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from JOY's official Submit Your Music and contact pages and its active Season Two 2026 schedule. The submission page also contains an unrelated newsletter form with a hidden validation field and CAPTCHA; that adjacent form is not a music-submission route and was not used.

platforms.name: 2XXfm 98.3 Canberra Global Download-Link Music Submission Form
platforms.country: Australia / Canberra community radio with a public worldwide music-submission form
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated on the official form.
platforms.manualReviewReason: The official form accepts artists worldwide and requests identity and contact data, a brief biography, social links and a high-quality downloadable WAV, FLAC or 320-kbps-equivalent audio link. It includes a hidden validation field and CAPTCHA. A human must verify the asset link and rights, complete the fields normally and solve the CAPTCHA without automation.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from 2XXfm's official Submit Music page and active 50th-anniversary programming dated July 2, 2026. The form includes a worldwide country selector. No form fields were entered, no CAPTCHA was handled and no link or file was delivered.

platforms.name: Cam FM 97.2 Cambridge Direct Head of Music Email Submission Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / Cambridge University and Anglia Ruskin student radio with a dedicated public music-submission mailbox
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee, login or payment requirement is stated on Cam FM's official contact route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Cam FM explicitly directs music submissions to its dedicated Head of Music mailbox but does not publish complete file-format, attachment, download-link, release-window or metadata rules on the contact page. A human must prepare a concise inquiry or submission, confirm the preferred asset format and approve all links and copy before sending.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from Cam FM's official contact and committee pages. music@camfm.co.uk is published as the dedicated submission address and belongs to the current Head of Music role. The live schedule and 2017-2026 footer confirm current operation. No email was sent and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probe was performed.

platforms.name: University Radio Nottingham Artist Collaboration Pre-Submission Inquiry Route
platforms.country: United Kingdom / Nottingham university radio with an official artist-collaboration contact route
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is published for the official artist contact route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: URN publishes a dedicated contact for artists who would like to work with the station, but it does not state that unsolicited audio may be sent or provide file, link, metadata or eligibility requirements. The safe authorized action is an asset-free human inquiry asking for the current music-consideration process; no music, attachments or private links should be delivered until URN replies.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from URN's official About page and active now-playing and schedule surfaces. The station states that it broadcasts worldwide during term time and carries specialist music across almost every genre. The artist contact is protected/non-plaintext in the fetched page and was not decoded, contacted or probed.
